'''DuroTech''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturing company presumably based on or in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. Duro Tech manufactured the [[Mneffe-class Superluminal|''Mneffe''-class superluminal shuttle]].
